patthana23.6:1.1: Nakusalaṃ napītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana23.6:2.1: Nakusalaṃ nasukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana23.6:3.1: Nakusalaṃ naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
